summary: Russian forces have approached several Ukrainian positions near Slavyansk according to Pushilin. Ukraine experienced multiple drone and missile attacks including strikes on Zaporizhzhia, Kharkiv, Odesa, and Dnipro with casualties. Ukraine conducted drone strikes on Engels airbase and shadow fleet tankers in the Black Sea.
key_points: Russian Armed Forces have approached several Ukrainian positions near Slavyansk, stated Pushilin in an interview with TASS (Source: @tass_agency/385592).
Russian drones struck four cargo ships in the ports of Chernomorsk and Dneprovsko-Bugsky in Odessa and Nikolaev regions (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31667).
Three KAB bombs hit Zaporizhzhia killing three people with one likely under rubble and causing destruction and fires (Source: @UkraineNow/82703).
SBU and Navy struck two shadow fleet tankers in Black Sea with maritime drones; Russian aviation attempted to destroy them unsuccessfully (Source: @UkraineNow/82689).
Explosions occurred in Engels, Saratov region, with drones hitting residential buildings and likely the military airbase used for strikes on Ukraine (Source: @UkraineNow/82680).
Zelensky assigned Yevgeny Khmara to act as Defense Minister after Fedorov's resignation (Source: @UkraineNow/82705).
Russian Geran-4 type drones struck four cargo ships in Chernomorsk and Dneprovsko-Bugsky ports (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31667).
Protests against Fedorov's dismissal occurred in Kiev, Lvov, Dnepropetrovsk and rallies in nine other cities (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31662).

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces have approached several Ukrainian positions near Slavyansk according to Pushilin. Ukraine suffered drone and missile attacks on Zaporizhzhia, Kharkiv, Odesa, and Dnipro causing deaths and injuries. Ukraine struck the Engels airbase and two Russian shadow fleet tankers in the Black Sea using drones.

points: Zelensky assigned Yevgeny Khmara, former acting SBU head, to perform duties of Defense Minister after Fedorov's resignation (Source: @UkraineNow/82705). Aleksey Viskub was appointed acting Minister of Defense per ukr_leaks_eng (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31682).

Fedorov resigned as Defense Minister; Zelensky cited failure to implement TCC reform and conflict with Syrsky as reasons (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31658). Fedorov refused offer to stay as advisor (Source: @UkraineNow/82694).

Deputy Commander of Air Forces Pavlo Yelizarov resigned citing Fedorov's dismissal as 'great evil' for defense (Source: @DeepStateUA/23653). Protests against dismissal occurred in Kiev, Lvov, Dnepropetrovsk and rallies in nine cities (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31662).

Verkhovna Rada supported Sergey Koretskyi as Prime Minister and new government composition including Shmyhal, Berezhna, and others (Source: @DeepStateUA/23655). Zelensky freed Timur Tkachenko as Kyiv military administration head (Source: @UkraineNow/82708).

Britain will provide 300 million euros to help supply Swedish Gripen fighters to Ukraine, per PM Starmer in Kyiv (Source: @UkraineNow/82702). Fedorov said Ukraine contracted 12,000 ground robotic systems last year and 50,000 this year (Source: @UkraineNow/82694).

SBU and Navy struck two Russian shadow fleet tankers in Black Sea with maritime drones; Russian aviation used machine guns and bombs unsuccessfully (Source: @UkraineNow/82689). Two officials detained over Vyshnevoye warehouse explosions (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31678).

Explosions occurred overnight in Engels, Saratov region; drones hit residential buildings and likely attacked Engels military airbase, key strategic aviation base (Source: @UkraineNow/82680). The base launches missiles at Ukraine.
Pushilin stated Russian Armed Forces approached several Ukrainian positions near Slavyansk in an interview with TASS (Source: @tass_agency/385592). No further operational details provided in message.
Traffic on Crimea Bridge resumed per Telegram channel on situation at approaches (Source: @tass_agency/385609). No cause of prior disruption stated in message.

Russian drones of Geran-4 type struck four cargo ships in ports of Chernomorsk and Dneprovsko-Bugsky in Odessa and Nikolaev regions (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31667). A Russian drone struck a bulk carrier heading to Chornomorsk port (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31681).
Russian aviation attempted to destroy Ukrainian maritime drones with machine gun fire and bombs during Black Sea tanker strike, without result (Source: @UkraineNow/82689).
Trump named Russia among 'US opponents' allegedly trying to influence American elections per TASS (Source: @tass_agency/385601). This is a political statement not a battlefield action.
Russian Armed Forces approached several Ukrainian positions near Slavyansk per Pushilin interview with TASS (Source: @tass_agency/385592). No unit names or distances stated.
Enemy tactical aviation active on eastern direction with threat of aviation munitions for frontline regions per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/68768). No specific locations beyond 'eastern direction'.
Drones reported on eastern Dnipropetrovsk toward Petropavlivka/Shakhterske with changing course, and south Donetsk near Dobropillya northward (Source: @kpszsu/68800). No strikes confirmed.

Two reactive drones reported from sea toward Chornomorsk-Odesa per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101282). Two controlled reactive drones to Odessa region from sea toward Chornomorsk (Source: @eRadarrua/101316).

Zaporizhzhia attacked by three KAB bombs killing three, one likely under rubble, with destroyed and damaged buildings (Source: @UkraineNow/82703). Two reactive drones on Zaporizhzhia toward Vilnyansk from Ternuvate (Source: @eRadarrua/101306).

Kharkiv region drones past Bohodukhiv toward Vilschan; Sumy region drone toward Stepanivka/Sumy (Source: @kpszsu/68805). Kharkiv drones on/past Krasnokutsk and Beresten from north (Source: @kpszsu/68821).
Sumy region drone past Khotin toward Sumy per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/68800). Sumy drones toward Nyzy and Krasnopillya from Chornobai per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101322).
Chernihiv region reactive drone toward Slavutych per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101297). No impact reported.
Zhytomyr region two reactive drones toward Korosten per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101297). No strikes stated.

Poltava threats: reactive drone approaching toward Shevchenkivskyi/Podilskyi districts (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69111); two reactive past Skorokhodove, one reactive Karlivka (Source: @eRadarrua/101334); drone toward Velyki Sorochyntsi (Source: @kpszsu/68789); toward Hradyzk (Source: @kpszsu/68779).

Possible missile launch from Bryansk region reported by mon1tor_ua (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69104). High threat of Iskander-M ballistic missile launch from Bryansk per mon1tor_ua (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69097).

Kyiv suffered Russian shelling overnight with two dead and five wounded including a child per UkraineNow (Source: @UkraineNow/82709). Protests outside Zelensky office against Fedorov dismissal (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31662).
SBU and Navy struck two Russian shadow fleet tankers in Black Sea with maritime drones; Russian aviation failed to destroy them (Source: @UkraineNow/82689). No coordinates given.

Russian Geran-4 drones struck four cargo ships in Chernomorsk and Dneprovsko-Bugsky ports, Odessa and Nikolaev regions (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31667). Russian drone hit bulk carrier to Chornomorsk with military supplies (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31681).
Odesa attacked with civilian infrastructure hit; one dead, two hospitalized (Source: @UkraineNow/82706). Two controlled reactive drones from sea toward Chornomorsk-Odesa (Source: @eRadarrua/101282).

Dnipropetrovsk reactive drone north of Sofiyivka toward north of Kryvyi Rih per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101281). Reactive drone from south toward Kamianske/Dnipro (Source: @eRadarrua/101278). Dnipro logistics warehouses damaged (Source: @UkraineNow/82706).
Kherson region drone toward Velyka Oleksandrivka from southeast per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/68827). No casualties stated.
Bombers from Crimea that launched missiles at Odesa returning to base airfields per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101314). No further detail.

Explosions in Engels, Saratov region hit residential buildings and likely military airbase, key Russian strategic aviation base for missile strikes (Source: @UkraineNow/82680). Some drones crashed into homes.
Enemy tactical aviation active on eastern direction threatening aviation munitions for frontline oblasts per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/68768). No aircraft type specified.
High threat of Iskander-M ballistic missile launch from Bryansk region per mon1tor_ua (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69097). Possible missile launch from Bryansk also reported (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69104).

Russian Geran-4 drones struck four cargo ships in Chernomorsk and Dneprovsko-Bugsky ports (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31667). Reactive drones tracked across multiple oblasts by kpszsu and eRadarrua with no confirmed impacts stated.
Deputy Commander of Air Forces Pavlo Yelizarov resigned after Fedorov dismissal (Source: @DeepStateUA/23653). No direct combat event cited.

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces closing on Slavyansk positions indicate intensified ground pressure on the eastern front (Source: @tass_agency/385592). Sustained drone and KAB attacks on Zaporizhzhia, Kharkiv, Odesa, and Dnipro with casualties show broad aerial threat to civilian areas (Source: @UkraineNow/82703, @UkraineNow/82706). High Iskander-M ballistic threat from Bryansk elevates risk to northern cities (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69097). Ukrainian strikes on Engels and Black Sea tankers demonstrate reciprocal deep strike capability against Russian assets (Source: @UkraineNow/82680, @UkraineNow/82689).
sections.regional_response: Britain pledged 300 million euros to support Gripen fighter delivery to Ukraine, with PM Starmer affirming continued support in Kyiv (Source: @UkraineNow/82702). EU seeks explanation from Zelensky on Fedorov dismissal, surprised by resignation (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31671). Hungary's PM Madyar opened investigation into ex-FM Szijarto's Russia links (Source: @UkraineNow/82707). Verkhovna Rada confirmed Koretskyi government reshuffle (Source: @DeepStateUA/23655).
sections.intelligence_notes: Fedorov's resignation followed conflict with Syrsky over TCC reform; Zelensky refused to choose between them (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31658, @ukr_leaks_eng/31677). Public protests in multiple Ukrainian cities signal domestic friction over defense leadership change (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31662, @ukr_leaks_eng/31664). Ukraine contracted 12,000 ground robots last year and 50,000 this year per Fedorov (Source: @UkraineNow/82694). Detentions over Vyshnevoye warehouse blasts point to ammunition storage compliance failures (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31678).
